saints.name: William of Bourges
saints.legacy: A model of piety and humility
saints.summary: William of Bourges was an Archbishop known for his deep piety and commitment to a life of austerity. He initially served as a canon before joining the Cistercians and later became the Archbishop of Bourges, where he focused on leading a holy life and performing penance for others. His tomb became a site of numerous miracles, leading to his canonization just nine years after his death.
